meta.title: Who Posted It?
meta.instructions: Someone at Kestrel Hall keeps posting on the anonymous Whisper Wall. Read each post and tap who wrote it. Streaks score more. Beat Jules's 1600 within 12 posts; three wrong calls and you're out of the group chat.

shown_text.body: if typing() then substr(post_text(), 0, floor(len(post_text()) * (now - typed_at) * 1.0 / 1200.0)) + '▍' else post_text()

children.text: = if called_it() then 'CALLED IT' else 'IT WAS ' + upper(first_name(correct_answer()))

toast.text: Three in a row! 200 a post now

art.style: Prep-school drama after dark: plum velvet, gold lattice, ivy on the arches, a glossy anonymous post card and crown lives.

posts: Whoever parked a golf cart in MY spot at formal committee: I know your mother. Per my last warning.
the tide goes out / and so does my shot percentage / coach, I am a poem
Reminder: the library opens at 6:00, not 6:05. Some of us fit three study blocks in before breakfast.
Lost: one crate of contraband cheese puffs. Found: my will to live. Reward: also cheese puffs.
SQUIRREL ON THE QUAD. SQUIRREL ON THE QUAD. WHY IS NOBODY DOING ANYTHING
If the formal theme is 'Under the Sea' again I will personally drain the ocean. Babe, I'm not kidding.
Scored twice today. Still thinking about the sunset after practice. Is that weird. Don't answer.
To whoever borrowed my chem notes: the purple tabs are load-bearing. Return them by 7:45. Sharp.
The fire drill at 2:00 was not me. The fire drill at 2:15 was me. Learn the difference.
Someone dropped a whole sandwich under table four. It is gone now. I regret nothing. I am a good girl.
My sailing coach says I 'lack humility'. Okay, so why did his boat finish behind mine?
Got a 99. Asked for the missing point back. Got it. Then asked about extra credit. Tell no one.
Selling gum in the east stairwell, two for one. Ask for 'the dentist'. Teachers: this is a joke. (It is not.)
Wrote a haiku for my dog, Pancake. He ate it. Honestly? Fair review.
THE MAIL CARRIER HAS RETURNED. HE IS A TRAITOR. I HAVE WARNED THIS SCHOOL BEFORE.
